comment: Server layout per docs/community/discord-server-setup.md part 4. '@bot' is the bot's own top role, '@everyone' the base role. Announcement channels are created as text until Community is enabled, then converted.

channels.name: welcome
channels.topic: Start here: what this server is and where to go.

channels.topic: Server rules. Read them before posting.
